design.capability: Same frozen intervention and strict matched control on fixed 2200 MC items + 140 references using discovery-median offsets and fixed hash orientation per item. Two-operation exact simultaneous NI bounds, 2pp.
design.confirmatory_gate: Per task: n >= planning minimum; targeted alternate first-word gain >=10pp, two-sided paired p<.025 vs clean and >=5pp above norm control. Scope is independent baseline-correct low-margin cases. Compare task replications separately, no pool substitution.
design.factorial: 64 backgrounds × evidence E, choice S, draft D (2×2×2). Each pair changes exactly one token. Outcome orientation fishing minus mining. Compare E with S=A vs B, S when E differs vs equals B, D at fixed E/S. Background clustered.
design.fit: Native Head/MLP prefix outputs at evidence token, key token and two common tail tokens. Fit mean E paired differences from S=A and project out the nuisance span spanned by D and S-with-same-answer differences per native writer across roles.
design.holdout: Up to 1536 backgrounds per task. Enroll first 104 clean-correct cases per task with gap in (0,8] from deterministic input order, or use all eligible if short. Fixed batches of four, pad evaluation if required; use original screen batch when exact clean word/gap fails. New dispatch workflow has a separate call-sign → case → permit → crew join, uses the same answer vocabulary, and receives the same frozen writer group and dose.
design.interventions: Directed addition toward opposite answer, half dose, head-only, MLP-only, strict equal-norm signed-permutation direction at identical native coordinates. Full cache change replay and clean restoration, plus source-only. Preserve actual four-token greedy output and all failures.
design.selection: 64 disjoint development backgrounds, originally with wrong draft and S=A. Rank components using actual answer-gap gradient dotted with fixed E direction. Test a compact and broad mixed Head/MLP group at α in {1,4,8} on clean-correct development examples, against same-vector strict norm control. Maximize targeted first-word improvement over control, then direction-sensitive gap effect, then smaller group and dose. Freeze before accessing heldout outcomes. Report when no discovery configuration passes behavioral effect.
